items.title: An isomorphism of the lower shrieks of the structure sheaves gives a base change formula for the lower shriek
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-cohomology.tex (Cohomology on Sites)

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that an isomorphism L pi_!A_bullet = L pi_!B_bullet implies a base change formula for the lower shriek after extending scalars (statement lines 10822-10833). The proof (proof lines 10835-10853) reduces to a flat module over the simplicial sheaf of rings, computes both sides through the two computation lemmas for the lower shriek, and finishes with the auxiliary computation on the fibre categories. H2: one reduction plus one localisation to fibres, written out.
